title: UK entertainment industry faces 'reckoning' over sex scandals

blocks.text: LONDON — Britain’s world-renowned entertainment sector is facing mounting calls to usher in sweeping reforms and greater oversight, amid a fresh slew of rape and sexual abuse allegations against some of its powerful male stars. “The media industry will need to look at itself and ensure whether it is taking all of the steps needed to protect the safety of women and girls who work within the industry,” Prime Minister Andy Burnham warned late Thursday, Nov. 12, after days of torrid headlines. Comedian and ex-Hollywood actor Russell Brand was on Monday jailed for over 10 years for rape and sexual assault against […]...
